requirement: User can register with valid required details
notes: Confirm required fields and validation rules against the actual contract

requirement: Duplicate email cannot create a second account
notes: Registration must not create a duplicate user

requirement: Valid credentials establish an authenticated session
notes: Verify token/session behavior against the implemented contract

requirement: Invalid credentials do not authenticate a user
notes: Verify response and absence of an authenticated session

requirement: Protected resources reject requests without valid authentication
notes: Check protected profile and order routes independently

requirement: Product listing returns valid product information
notes: Required fields and types must match the current contract

requirement: Product filtering returns intended results when implemented
notes: Mark not applicable only when filtering is not implemented

requirement: Cart quantities and totals follow documented pricing rules
notes: Do not assume selectors or quantity behavior without checking the DOM

requirement: Checkout requires an authenticated user
notes: Server-side enforcement is required even if the UI redirects

requirement: Valid orders persist with consistent order and item data
notes: Include order total reconciliation

requirement: Orders cannot exceed available stock and inventory changes remain consistent
notes: Also investigate concurrent stock changes where supported

requirement: Payment failure and timeout leave order/payment state consistent
notes: Confirm actual mock-payment contract

requirement: Only authorized administrators can access administrative logs
notes: DEF-001 is linked to this requirement

requirement: Required audit events are recorded without unauthorized disclosure
notes: Verify audit requirements before asserting exact events

requirement: Health endpoint reports status according to its contract
notes: Confirm expected fields and readiness meaning

requirement: AI outputs satisfy defined correctness grounding and safety requirements when AI feature exists
notes: Conditional: do not claim execution if the feature is unavailable

requirement: Registration rejects malformed email addresses
notes: DEF-003 is linked to this requirement; REQ-02 remains specifically about duplicate accounts

requirement: Order creation requires authentication at the API boundary
notes: DEF-002 is linked to this requirement

requirement: Repeated order submission follows documented idempotency rules
notes: Do not assume idempotency exists unless confirmed by the API contract

requirement: Stored order total agrees with trusted item prices and documented pricing rules
notes: Client-supplied total-price tampering remains an investigation until reproduced
